question: Nam ______ football with his classmates every afternoon.
explanation:
📌 Grammar: Subject 'Nam' is singular (he), so in Present Simple we add -s/-es to the verb: plays.
💡 Every afternoon indicates Present Simple tense.
⚠️ Do not forget the third person singular ending -s.

question: She is very hard-working. She ______ forgets to do her homework.
explanation:
📌 Adverbs of frequency: 'hard-working' (chăm chỉ) means she never (không bao giờ) forgets homework.
💡 Context clues are vital in choosing frequency adverbs.
⚠️ Always would mean she is forgetful!
